dotfiles_dir.description: The path to the directory containing the source rc files.

tags.description: Tags to include during rcup operations. Corresponds to tag-* subdirectories.

excludes.description: Patterns or files to exclude from management. Supports scoping like 'dir:file'. Corresponds to -x flag.

undotted.description: Names of files or directories that should be created without a leading dot. Corresponds to -U flag context.
